title: Only 11% Of Adults Pass This Bible Quiz
summary: Ten questions spanning famous people, places and stories from the Old and New Testaments.

landing.intro:
10 Bible questions. No looking up answers.
How many will you know?

about.body:
This ten-question entertainment quiz covers well-known people, places, books and events from the Bible. Questions draw from both the Old and New Testaments and avoid points that depend heavily on a particular modern translation.

Choose one answer for each question. After revealing your score, you can unlock a review of the questions you answered incorrectly and their correct answers.

Book names and ordering can vary between religious traditions. This general-knowledge quiz uses common Christian conventions.

steps: Answer ten Bible questions in one focused challenge.
Choose one of four answers for every question.
Reveal your score, then unlock the correct answers to the questions you missed.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and general learning only. This quiz does not assess faith, belief or religious knowledge formally.

stage-1.preAdCopy: Your ten answers have been checked. Your Bible quiz score is ready to reveal.

profile-1.title: The Bible Scholar
profile-1.copy: You answered nine or ten questions correctly—a strong result across this quiz. The score reflects these ten questions, not your faith or a formal qualification in biblical studies.

profile-2.title: The Scripture Expert
profile-2.copy: You answered eight of the ten questions correctly and reached this quiz’s 80% target. Unlock the review to see the correct answers to the two questions you missed.

profile-3.title: The Attentive Reader
profile-3.copy: You answered six or seven questions correctly. One or two more correct answers would have taken you to 80%. The optional review shows the answers to the questions you missed.

profile-4.title: The Curious Student
profile-4.copy: You answered four or five questions correctly. Unlock the review to revisit the questions you missed and see their correct answers.

profile-5.title: The New Explorer
profile-5.copy: You answered fewer than four questions correctly. Some names or stories may have been unfamiliar. If you want to explore them, unlock the correct answers to the questions you missed.
